page.layout: One printed page, one text column. Running head at the top. Heading in italics below the first passage. Four paragraphs and the closing line of text, with a catchword at the bottom right. No page number and no margin notes.

main_text.p: vinarum scripturarum disciplina, queadmodū magnus perhibet Dyonisius. Quod si discepta-verit, & ita libenter facere & docere minimè sponderit, nullatenus consecretur. Ait enim prophetæ Deus. Tu scientiā repulisti, & ego re-pellam te, ne sacerdotio fungaris mihi.
Vide Decreta Gelasij & Zosimi Pontificū Dist.36. C. Illiteratos, &, Qui ecclesiasticis. Quibus mox subiungit Gratianus.)

Ecce quod sacrarum literarum oportet Episcopum habere peritiam. Unde in veteri testa-mento inter cætera ornamenta pontifex rationale ferebat in pectore, in quo scribebatur, Manifestatio & veritas, quia in pectore pontificis, manifesta debet esse cognitio veritatis, &c.

Colligit deinceps multa scripturarum testi-monia & exempla. Tandem concludit. Ex quibus omnibus liquido colligitur, quod non suf-ficit prælatis bona conuersatio & morum ho-nestas, nisi addatur scientia doctrinæ.

Et mox ibidem. C. si quis vult. Ex Hieronymo. Hæc duo sunt pontificis opera ut a Deo di-scat legendo scripturas divinas, & sæpius medi-tando, aut populū doceat. Sed illa doceat, quæ a Deo ipse didicerat, non ex proprio corde, vel humano sensu, sed quæ Spiritus sanctus docet.

page.notes: The page is slightly stained at the top and right edge. The reading "SENTENTIAE DE" in the running head ends in a symbol that is unclear, so it is marked [?]. The accent over "scientia" and the sign over "queadmodum" and "populum" are read as abbreviation marks (macron or tilde). The reading "scientiā" is uncertain and may be a printed accent. The closing word "De" is the catchword at the foot of the page.
